name: ernestdefoe/parley
description: Parley — chat for Flarum 2. See who is online and what they are reading, and message them in windows that stay open while you browse.

suggest.flarum/realtime: Delivers messages, typing and read receipts instantly. Without it Parley polls every 5 seconds.
suggest.ernestdefoe/parley-calls: Voice and video calls, screen share and picture-in-picture.
